about_the_game:
Stab… stab… stab. 

How much more pain will these twisted games demand? And how long until the torment finally ends — if it ever does?

Trapped: Forced To Kill is Inspired by popular titles - Danganronpa, Your Turn to Die and Saya No Uta. 

______________________________________________________________

You wake up in a room that isn’t yours.

You play as Ciara Mori, a teenaged girl, and something is deeply wrong.

A voice echoes from the shadows...he laughs.  And mocks you.
You’re not alone — eleven strangers are trapped here with you.
The rules are simple: Play the games. Survive.  And don't go...insane. 

But the rules are always changing.

And the one pulling the strings… seems to enjoy it a little too much.

As trust begins to rot and the games get worse, you’ll form bonds, make impossible choices, and confront the ugliest parts of yourself.

And maybe — just maybe — someone will bleed for you.

Or... you'll be the one bleeding instead.

______________________________________________________________

Content Warning:

The full game contains themes and visuals that may be disturbing or upsetting to some players.

  • Intense psychological horror

  • Death, torture, and graphic violence

  • Dark humor and dark romance

  • Crude language and mature content

  • Depictions of trauma, bullying, and emotional distress

  • Intense gore and grotesque imagery

______________________________________________________________

DEMO UPDATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 

The Trapped: Forced to Kill demo has officially been updated — and it’s better than ever.

- Sharper writing

- Stronger pacing

- 16 Unlockable CG's

- A more unsettling, intense tone

-And yes... even darker humor

Think you're ready to face the horrors waiting inside?

Play the updated demo now — I promise you won't regret it.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

DISCLAIMER:

TFTK is inspired by the popular titles but isn't exactly like them. Alot of things will be different and TFTK will have its own uniqueness.

Please note:

I am working Solo on this project so progress might take longer than usual. I am very passionate about this project, so I am continuing to work hard every day to create something people will love.

For updates, please follow my TikTok: TJS_Productions where I post quite regularly!

Trapped: Forced To Kill will also be on itch.io (Demo and Full).
